sql: CREATE SCHEMASTORE VIEW price_book WITH CONTAINER kola AS SELECT r.effective_date AS effective_date, r.sku AS sku, r.city AS city, CAST(r.old_price_ngn AS DOUBLE) AS old_price_ngn, CAST(r.new_price_ngn AS DOUBLE) AS new_price_ngn, r.reason AS reason FROM kola_systems.price_book_src LATERAL VIEW explode(records) AS r
